name: run_ledger_cross_zero
description: One sell fill crosses a long position through zero: the old long is closed and realized against its entry, then the remainder opens a new short at the execution price. A later mark proves the new short uses the new entry.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL +2 @100 fee=0: entry=100, mark=100, wallet 1000, equity 1000. FILL -5 @90 fee=0: crosses zero (old qty +2, fill -5). Close leg: realize (exec-entry)*closed_qty*mult*sign(position)=(90-100)*2*1*(+1)=-20; wallet=1000-20=980; realized_cum=-20. Open leg: remainder 5-2=3 contracts short at exec=90 -> position -3, entry=90. mark=90 (fill price); unrealized=-3*1*(90-90)=0; equity=980. MARK mark_price=80: unrealized=-3*1*(80-90)=-3*(-10)=+30; wallet stays 980; equity=980+30=1010. If the entry had wrongly stayed 100, unrealized would be -3*(80-100)=60 and equity 1040; expected 1010 pins the reset entry. Final: wallet 980, unrealized 30, equity 1010, realized -20, fees 0, funding 0, position -3. Per-event equity processing order: [1000, 980, 1010].
